title: refactor(web): use actions and ui lib context menu
body:
For the people card component, use the existing actions in the people service over custom callbacks to the people page code. Then, use the ui lib context menu. Simplify the show/hide logic for the button to use `group-hover:opacity-100` instead of the mouse position detection.

For the activity viewer, merge the context menu code into a reusable snippet, and again use the ui lib context menu.

No visual changes except for old->new context menu.
